result.description: White-label payment gateway (NMI-powered) for card processing, vault/recurring billing and reporting; the API is NMI's Payment API.
result.auth_detail: Merchant-generated private security key (Settings > Security Keys, "API" permission) sent as security_key form field on the Payment API/Query API. v4 API uses a key in the Authorization header. No OAuth.
result.access_detail: Keys are created inside an existing merchant gateway account. The brand "Paygent Connect" has no findable public developer portal or signup. NMI is a white-label gateway sold through channel partners and ISOs. A key from a sandbox account does not work on the standard gateway. A public free signup could not be confirmed.
result.api_notes: NMI Payment API (Classic, form-encoded POST: auth, sale, credit, void, refund, validate), Customer Vault, recurring billing, Query API for reporting, plus an in-progress v4 API. The coverage is NMI's, not a Paygent-specific API. I could not confirm that Paygent Connect exposes it directly, and no Paygent-branded docs were found.
result.blocker: No public Paygent Connect developer docs or signup were found. Credentials only exist inside a merchant account provisioned by Paygent or its NMI reseller. The brand-to-NMI mapping is unverified. Building on generic NMI is possible but needs a test account.

evidence.quote: To obtain an API key from your NMI gateway, first click on settings.
401 Unauthorized - a missing API Key or an invalid API Key was sent in the request.
If you are an existing NMI partner, you can generate a new security key within the Merchant Portal.
The transaction type must be one of auth, sale, credit, offline, or validate.
It works with any NMI white-label gateway if pointed at that gateway's host.
